title: Mixed Exam Cover
style_notes: Premium CORTEX liquid-glass medical cover with clean 2D vector line art and mobile-first hierarchy.
composition_notes: Central title card with four compact domain capsules: Neurologi, Psikiatri, Farmakologi, Forensik.
color_notes: Blue-purple pastel gradient with cyan, lavender, mint, and amber domain accents.
caption: Peta pembuka untuk review cepat Batch 5.
alt_text: A premium medical dashboard cover for Batch 5 Mixed Quick Reference with domain capsules for neurology, psychiatry, pharmacology, and forensic medicine.
prompt: Design a premium 2D educational medical poster cover for the CORTEX app. Main title text: 'Batch 5 Mixed Quick Reference'. Subtitle: 'Neurologi • Psikiatri • Farmakologi • Forensik'. Use a liquid-glass interface style with translucent rounded cards, subtle reflections, blue and purple pastel gradients, and medium-weight line art. Add four simple domain icons: brain outline, sleep crescent, medicine capsule, and legal document or scale. Make it mobile-friendly, uncluttered, high hierarchy, and readable.

title: Glossary Strip
style_notes: Compact glossary cards with short labels, clean icons, and liquid-glass CORTEX styling.
composition_notes: Group terms into Neuroanatomi/Lesi, Psikiatri/Tidur, and Farmakologi/Forensik rows.
color_notes: Cyan for neurology, lavender for psychiatry, mint for pharmacology, amber for forensic terms.
caption: Istilah inti Batch 5 dalam format cepat baca.
alt_text: A glossary strip with concise cards for PPDGJ III, dissomnia, parasomnia, TIA, UMN, LMN, BBB, myelin, Horner syndrome, ECT, SSRI, and M’Naghten rule.
prompt: Create a mobile-friendly premium medical glossary strip for the CORTEX app. Include short Indonesian term cards only: 'PPDGJ III', 'Dissomnia', 'Parasomnia', 'TIA', 'UMN', 'LMN', 'BBB', 'Mielin', 'Sindrom Horner', 'ECT', 'SSRI', 'Aturan M’Naghten'. Each card should have a tiny clean icon and a very short clue phrase, for example 'UMN: spastik + hiperrefleksia', 'LMN: flaksid + atrofi', 'Horner: ptosis-miosis-anhidrosis', 'ECT: terapi kejang listrik'. Use liquid-glass translucent cards, blue-purple premium gradients, clear spacing, and high readability.
negative_prompt: No full paragraphs, no illegible microtext, no cluttered table, no photographic patient imagery, no gore, no unsupported extra terms, no distorted Indonesian words.

title: Lesion Matrix
style_notes: Schematic neuroanatomy matrix for fast lesion localization recall.
composition_notes: Three-column matrix: Lokasi, Clue klinis, Jebakan soal, with compact brain and skull-base line art.
color_notes: Deep navy text, cyan lesion markers, purple headers, amber trap chips.
caption: Lokalisasi lesi utama untuk soal neurologi Batch 5.
alt_text: A lesion localization matrix mapping Horner syndrome, cavernous sinus syndrome, cerebellopontine angle, internal capsule, MCA territory, frontal lobe tumor, and pituitary adenoma to clinical clues.
prompt: Create a clean 2D medical lesion localization matrix for neurology exam review. Use Indonesian labels. Rows: 'Sindrom Horner — ptosis, miosis, anhidrosis'; 'Sinus kavernosus — N III, IV, VI, V1/V2, ICA'; 'Cerebellopontine angle — N VIII'; 'Kapsula interna — defisit motorik fokal'; 'A. cerebri media — hemiparesis/pelo mendadak'; 'Lobus frontal — perubahan perilaku, fungsi eksekutif'; 'Adenoma hipofisis — keluhan neuro-oftalmologi'. Columns: 'Lokasi', 'Clue klinis', 'Jebakan soal'. Use schematic brain and skull-base line art, subtle lesion dots, premium liquid-glass cards, high readability, and an uncluttered mobile layout.
negative_prompt: No detailed surgical anatomy, no blood, no photorealistic skull, no overly dense labels, no unsupported cranial nerve claims, no messy arrows, no microscopic text.

title: Drug Mechanism Strip
style_notes: Concise medication mechanism strip with mechanism-to-clue arrows and minimal dosing content.
composition_notes: Two rows: psychopharmacology and neuropharmacology, using connected glass capsule cards.
color_notes: Mint for drugs, violet for psychopharm, cyan for neuropharm, red-orange badges for side-effect traps.
caption: Mekanisme obat penting untuk review Batch 5.
alt_text: A medication reference strip showing typical antipsychotics, atypical antipsychotics, SSRI, TCA, mood stabilizers, mannitol, pyridoxine, antivertigo drugs, and methadone.
prompt: Design a premium CORTEX medical reference strip for neuropsychiatric pharmacology. Use short Indonesian labels with clean mechanism arrows: 'APG-1/tipikal → blokade dopamin D2 → EPS lebih dominan'; 'APG-2/atipikal → serotonin + dopamin/D4'; 'SSRI → serotonin reuptake'; 'TCA/amitriptilin → efek antikolinergik'; 'Mood stabilizer → lithium/valproat/karbamazepin/lamotrigin'; 'Manitol → diuretik osmotik'; 'Piridoksin + INH → cegah neuropati perifer'; 'Metadon → terapi penyalahgunaan heroin'; 'Dimenhidrinat/Meklizin → antivertigo'. Use translucent rounded cards, medium-weight receptor icons, high contrast, and a blue-purple-mint palette.
negative_prompt: No invented dosing charts, no brand logos, no pill photography, no clutter, no tiny unreadable drug names, no unsupported treatment algorithms.

title: Clinical Symptom Flow
style_notes: Pattern-recognition flowchart for exam review, not a clinical guideline.
composition_notes: Top-down flow from dominant symptom to conservative diagnosis anchor.
color_notes: Cyan for acute neurology, purple for psychiatry, indigo for sleep, amber for trauma, mint for infection.
caption: Alur cepat dari gejala ke pola diagnosis.
alt_text: A symptom-to-diagnosis flowchart linking sudden focal deficits, biconvex hyperdense CT after trauma, chronic worry, trauma symptoms, appearance preoccupation, and abnormal sleep events to likely exam concepts.
prompt: Create a mobile-first medical flowchart for CORTEX titled 'Gejala → Diagnosis: Batch 5'. Use Indonesian labels. Branches: 'Defisit fokal mendadak → Stroke/TIA'; 'Trauma kepala + CT hiperdens bikonveks → Hematoma epidural'; 'Nyeri kepala + muntah/papiledema → peningkatan TIK / massa intrakranial'; 'HIV + lesi fokal otak → Toksoplasmosis serebri'; 'Khawatir hampir setiap hari → Gangguan ansietas menyeluruh'; 'Trauma berat >1 bulan → PTSD'; 'Preokupasi penampilan → Body dysmorphic disorder'; 'Peristiwa abnormal saat tidur → Parasomnia'; 'Gangguan kualitas/jumlah/waktu tidur → Dissomnia'; 'Memori buruk pada depresi → Pseudodemensia'. Use clean arrows, liquid-glass nodes, premium blue-purple palette, and high readability.
negative_prompt: No complex clinical guideline claims, no medication recommendations, no crowded diagnostic manual page, no tiny text, no photorealistic distress imagery, no gore, no extra diagnoses outside listed concepts.
